title: Artistic Project Entitlement v1
description: Allowance state for a guest artistic QR project. Bound to an opaque project access token, not a customer account.

project_access_token_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the opaque project access token.

total_rounds_allowed.description: Total generation rounds permitted. artistic_project=3, extra_exploration=2.

rounds_consumed.description: Rounds consumed only when candidates are successfully returned.

total_candidates_allowed.description: Maximum candidates across all rounds. artistic_project=12, extra_exploration=8.

exports_allowed.description: Finished artwork exports permitted. artistic_project=1, extra_exploration=1.

checkout_session_id.description: Link to the commerce checkout session that granted this entitlement.

expires_at.description: Optional expiration for the project access window.
